STEP 5. Check the passenger's door lock actuator 
operation.
Remove the passenger's door lock actuator to check. (Refer to 
GROUP 42, Door − Door Handle and Latch P.42-79.)
Q: Is the passenger's door lock actuator in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 6.
NO : Replace the passenger's door lock actuator. All doors 
should be locked or unlocked.
STEP 6. Check the ETACS-ECU connector C-114 and 
passenger's door lock actuator connector E-07 for 
damage.
Q: Are ETACS-ECU connector C-114 and passenger's door 
lock actuator connector E-07 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. All doors 
should be locked or unlocked.
